transform_embedding_response: transform the Perplexity embedding API response into an OpenAI-compatible EmbeddingResponse object
decode_base64_embedding: decode a base64-encoded int8 embedding from Perplexity into a list of normalized float values
validate_environment: validate the Perplexity embedding environment and return headers with a Bearer token from environment variables
transform_embedding_request: transform OpenAI embedding request parameters into the Perplexity API request format
get_complete_url: build the complete Perplexity embeddings API URL from a custom api_base or the default endpoint
